raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Splits the `(L4) Pipeline + Context Parallelism` job (~40 min of pytest in one serial job, recent `main` runs at 41–43 min wall against a 55 min timeout) into three named Pipeline Parallelism jobs: a 4-way hash-sharded `Models` job over a new `tests/distributed/pipeline_parallel/` folder, plus one-replica `CUDAGraph` and `DP V2` jobs. Test selection is unchanged on every lane: the monolith `test_pipeline_parallel.py` is split into per-family wrappers with the same 29 cases and params, and no `-k`/`-m`/`--ignore` filters are added. Every new job has an AMD mirror.

## Old

One job per lane ran three pytest commands serially:

- `:nvidia: (L4) Pipeline + Context Parallelism` (`pipeline-context-parallelism-4-gpus`): `test_pp_cudagraph.py` (1 case), `test_pipeline_parallel.py` (29 cases, most of the runtime), `v1/distributed/test_pp_dp_v2.py` (6 cases)
- `:amd: (MI250) Pipeline + Context Parallelism`: mirror of the above (the DP V2 file skips on ROCm)

The name is historical: #23734 added `test_context_parallel.py` to this job only as a commented-out line. That test runs in `(H100) Distributed Features` and `(B200) Distributed`, which this PR does not touch.

## New

| label | key | contents |
|---|---|---|
| :nvidia: (L4) Pipeline Parallelism Models Shard %N | `pipeline-parallelism-models-4-gpus`, `parallelism: 4` | `tests/distributed/pipeline_parallel/` (29 cases, pytest-shard) |
| :nvidia: (L4) Pipeline Parallelism CUDAGraph | `pipeline-parallelism-cudagraph-4-gpus` | `distributed/test_pp_cudagraph.py` |
| :nvidia: (L4) Pipeline Parallelism DP V2 | `pipeline-parallelism-dp-v2-4-gpus` | `v1/distributed/test_pp_dp_v2.py` |
| :amd: (MI250) Pipeline Parallelism Models Shard %N | generated `amd-pipeline-parallelism-models-4-gpus` | mirror, inherits `parallelism: 4` and the shard flags |
| :amd: (MI250) Pipeline Parallelism CUDAGraph | generated `amd-pipeline-parallelism-cudagraph-4-gpus` | mirror, one replica |
| :amd: (MI355) Pipeline Parallelism DP V2 | generated `amd-pipeline-parallelism-dp-v2-4-gpus` | mirror, all six cases with `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` (added by @AndreasKaratzas) |

The Models and CUDAGraph mirrors are copied from the original mirror (same device, inherited command). The DP V2 file previously skipped on ROCm; @AndreasKaratzas's commit makes it eligible there (`is_cuda_alike()`) and runs it on a four-GPU MI355 mirror, with the NVIDIA job and test scenarios unchanged.

Monolith split (`tests/distributed/test_pipeline_parallel.py` deleted):

```text
tests/distributed/pipeline_parallel/
├── __init__.py
├── _common.py                        # settings machinery, model catalog, _compare_tp — not collected
├── test_llama_mp.py                  # Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct detailed, mp backend (5)
├── test_llama_ray.py                 # Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct detailed, ray backend (5)
├── test_phi3_5_moe.py                # Phi-3.5-MoE detailed, multi_node_only (10)
├── test_language_generation.py       # Ilama / PowerLM / DeepSeek-V2-Lite / Jamba (4)
├── test_language_embedding.py        # e5-mistral / bge-multilingual-gemma2 (2)
└── test_multimodal_generation.py     # InternVL3 / Phi-3.5-vision / ultravox (3)
```

Consumers of the shared file move with it:

- `(L4) Distributed 2-Node` runs `VLLM_MULTI_NODE=1 pytest -v -s distributed/pipeline_parallel/` (whole folder; same cases run/skip as before).
- `(L4) RayExecutorV2` replaces `pytest distributed/test_pipeline_parallel.py -k "ray"` with `pytest -v -s distributed/pipeline_parallel/test_llama_ray.py`. The only ray-backend cases that run on a single node are Llama's (the Phi-3.5-MoE ray cases are `multi_node_only` and skip), so coverage is unchanged and the `-k` filter is gone.
- Legacy `test-amd.yaml` (`amd-ci`): the MI250 Pipeline + Context Parallelism step runs the whole folder in place of the monolith, DP V2 moves to a new four-GPU MI355 step with the same settings as the inline mirror, and the MI300 RayExecutorV2 step runs `test_llama_ray.py`.
- CODEOWNERS entry updated to the folder.

## Notes

- Coverage equivalence is verified statically: the wrappers' `TEST_MODELS` union is exactly the original 11-model list, giving the same 29 cases with the same params (llama 5 mp + 5 ray, phi3.5-moe 10, 4 fast language, 2 embedding, 3 multimodal). `check_test_tethering.py`, `yaml.safe_load` on both pipeline files, ruff, and the `bash -n` join check for the edited `amd-ci` steps pass.
- Shard count is 4 on both lanes. `pytest-shard`'s hash assignment is deterministic, and at 3 shards one shard took far more than the others on both lanes (over the 20-minute target on the mirror lane).
- The DP V2 job triggers on `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/`, `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py` and `vllm/v1/executor/` (the paths from #57735) instead of all of `vllm/v1/`. #57735 (open) also edits the old job's dependencies; whichever lands second rebases.
- AI assistance was used for this change (evidence gathering, the split, YAML edits, local checks).

## Expected runtime and overhead

Predictions for the primary lane, from per-case pytest times in the earlier validation build (#90812, 3 shards) re-assigned with `pytest-shard` 0.1.2's hash (`int.from_bytes(sha256(nodeid).digest(), "little") % N`) at 4 shards.

| job | predicted pytest | predicted running wall | main overhead cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| Models Shard 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 | ~10.5 / ~8.1 / ~9.7 / ~6.6 min | pytest + ~0.8 min | checkout + image pull + env setup |
| CUDAGraph | ~2 min | ~2.7 min | same |
| DP V2 | ~4.2 min | ~5.1 min | same |

- Before: ~40.5 min pytest in one job (~42 min wall). After: slowest replica ~11.3 min wall; ~46.5 worker-minutes predicted, about 4.5 extra, within the 20-minute budget.
- Mirror lane: slowest Models shard is predicted well under the 20-minute target. The DP V2 mirror is new coverage (it was skip-only before), so its cost is additive rather than overhead. Measured per-replica numbers will follow in the validation comment.

## Validation (interim)

Builds: [`ci` #90812](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/90812) and [`amd-ci` #13522](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13522), commit `d9f63d35c8` (bootstrap confirmed `HEAD is now at d9f63d35c8`). All scoped jobs **passed** except `2-node-test-4-gpus`, which is still queued at this writing.

Coverage checks out on both lanes: the three Models shards ran 9+13+7 = **29 cases** (same 29 the old job ran), CUDAGraph ran 1, DP V2 ran 6 passed on the primary lane. The legacy `amd-ci` steps also passed: (MI250) Pipeline + Context Parallelism running the whole folder, and (MI300) RayExecutorV2 running `test_llama_ray.py`.

### Measured vs predicted

Primary lane:

| job | pytest (pred) | pytest (actual) | wall (actual) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Models shard 0 | ~11.5 | 11.3 | 12.1 |
| Models shard 1 | ~11.5 | 17.5 | 18.3 |
| Models shard 2 | ~11.5 | 6.5 | 7.3 |
| CUDAGraph | ~2 | 1.9 | 2.7 |
| DP V2 | ~4.5 | 4.2 | 5.1 |

Mirror lane:

| job | pytest (pred) | pytest (actual) | wall (actual) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Models shard 0 | ~14 | 13.8 | 15.4 |
| Models shard 1 | ~14 | **20.9** | 22.5 |
| Models shard 2 | ~14 | 8.6 | 10.1 |
| CUDAGraph | ~3-4 | 3.8 | 5.7 |

(Times in minutes; pytest = duration reported by pytest, wall = running job wall excluding queue wait. Per-shard skew from the mean is the deterministic `pytest-shard` hash assignment — it is stable across runs, not noise.)

### Budget verdicts

- **Aggregate worker-minutes:** primary lane 45.6 wall after vs ~41.3–42.6 before → **+3–4 min, within the 20-minute budget**. Mirror lane 53.6 after vs ~46–54 before → **+0–8 min, within budget**.
- **Slowest replica, primary lane:** 17.5 min pytest — **under the 20-minute target**.
- **Slowest replica, mirror lane:** 20.9 min pytest — **over target**. The hash assignment is deterministic, so this is structural, not a one-off draw.

### Fix

Added `parallelism: 4` to the mirror block only (`f04a7453a9`) — the mirror lane's cases run slower, so it gets one more shard while the primary lane stays at 3. Expected mirror shard time ~10–11 min. Aggregate cost stays within budget (+1 shard setup on the mirror lane). A scoped re-validation of `amd-pipeline-parallelism-models-4-gpus` on the new head will confirm; the `2-node-test-4-gpus` result will be reported here once its queued job runs.
@Thangnguyenvn98 I just pushed an equivalent mirror for AMD I hope that is OK, there is a wide effort to close parity gap of AMD mirrors.

Thanks @khluu, addressed in `8a2ab749e2`:

- **Shard count:** the NVIDIA Models job is now `parallelism: 4`. Re-assigning the per-case times from #90812 with `pytest-shard`'s hash (which reproduces that build's 3-shard split exactly) gives the same ~11.6 / 10.9 / 4.9 / 7.6 min. The MI250 mirror drops its explicit override and inherits the 4.
- **Fresh run on the current head, both lanes:** [`ci` #91252](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91252) (all three Pipeline Parallelism keys plus their three `amd-` mirrors) and [`amd-ci` #13628](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13628). Results will follow in a validation comment. 2-Node and RayExecutorV2 passed in #90812 and their commands haven't changed since, so they aren't re-run.
- **DP V2 triggers:** narrowed from `vllm/v1/` to `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/`, `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py` and `vllm/v1/executor/`, matching #57735.
- **Andreas's AMD mirror:** it had been lost in the earlier force-push. It's restored as his own commit (`e54f3d6ec9`, authorship kept), identical to what he pushed. @AndreasKaratzas, I left the mirror's own dependency list as you wrote it (it still lists all of `vllm/v1/`). Happy to narrow it the same way if you'd like.

## Validation

Builds: [`ci` #91252](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91252) and [`amd-ci` #13628](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13628), commit `8a2ab749e2` (every job's checkout confirmed `HEAD is now at 8a2ab749e2`). **All jobs passed, with no automatic retries.**

Coverage: the four Models shards ran 7 + 6 + 8 + 8 = **29 cases** on both lanes (the same 29 as the old job), CUDAGraph ran 1, DP V2 ran all 6 on both the primary lane and the new MI355 mirror. Legacy `amd-ci`: the MI250 Pipeline + Context Parallelism step (folder unsharded), the MI300 RayExecutorV2 step (`test_llama_ray.py`) and the new MI355 DP V2 step all passed.

**Correction to my earlier reply:** the 4-shard prediction I posted (~11.6 / 10.9 / 4.9 / 7.6) used the wrong byte order for `pytest-shard`'s hash. 0.1.2 uses `int.from_bytes(sha256(nodeid).digest(), "little")`; a 3-shard check can't tell the two orders apart because 256 ≡ 1 (mod 3). The corrected prediction is below; the shard count of 4 is unchanged.

### Primary lane, measured vs predicted

| job | pytest (pred) | pytest (actual) | running wall | non-pytest overhead | main overhead cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Models Shard 1 | ~10.5 | 11.1 | 12.0 | 0.9 | checkout + image pull + env setup |
| Models Shard 2 | ~8.1 | 8.7 | 9.6 | 0.9 | same |
| Models Shard 3 | ~9.7 | 9.4 | 10.2 | 0.8 | same |
| Models Shard 4 | ~6.6 | 6.9 | 7.8 | 0.9 | same |
| CUDAGraph | ~2 | 1.9 | 2.7 | 0.8 | same |
| DP V2 | ~4.2 | 4.4 | 5.3 | 0.9 | same |

(Minutes. pytest = durations reported by pytest; wall = job running time excluding queue wait.)

### Budget verdicts

- **Primary lane:** 47.6 worker-minutes after vs ~41.3–42.6 before (recent `main`), **+5–6 min, within the 20-minute budget**. Slowest replica **11.1 min pytest**, under the target with headroom.
- **Mirror lane:** every replica passed; the slowest Models shard is well inside the 20-minute target and down from the unsharded baseline, and the aggregate is within budget. The MI355 DP V2 mirror is new coverage (it was skip-only before), so its cost is additive rather than split overhead.
- 2-Node and RayExecutorV2 on the primary lane passed in #90812 and their commands are unchanged since.

## Validation (interim)

Builds: [`ci` #90812](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/90812) and [`amd-ci` #13522](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/13522), commit `d9f63d35c8` (bootstrap confirmed `HEAD is now at d9f63d35c8`). All scoped jobs **passed** except `2-node-test-4-gpus`, which is still queued at this writing.

Coverage checks out on both lanes: the three Models shards ran 9+13+7 = **29 cases** (same 29 the old job ran), CUDAGraph ran 1, DP V2 ran 6 passed on the primary lane. The legacy `amd-ci` steps also passed: (MI250) Pipeline + Context Parallelism running the whole folder, and (MI300) RayExecutorV2 running `test_llama_ray.py`.
